data.body: The regression is confirmed as caused by this change. Main sweep 44636174645 (job 135955149952) failed test_compose_startup_binding_fails_closed_on_bad_key. That test made its key bad with chmod 0644, which Windows does not refuse by design (nymph). It passed on Windows only while compose always failed on the OWNER RIGHTS copy. Reproduced on macOS with the Windows branch forced: DID NOT RAISE after the fix, and a pass when the pre-fix OWNER RIGHTS refusal is stubbed back in. The fix is tracked on lowfat-hydrated-koalabear and is test-only, with no skip: an invalid-everywhere key, plus a per-platform test of the group-readable rule. The AC boxes here were ticked before the regression was found. This ticket stays in_progress until the main sweep after that fix is clean.
